d: From the first beer brewed in ancient Sumer to modern craft breweries, this episode of Tarikh by The Lallantop explores the fascinating history of beer across civilizations. Discover how beer shaped agriculture, ancient Egypt, Babylon, medieval Europe, monasteries, hops, lager, pilsner, the Industrial Revolution, American Prohibition, and the craft beer revolution. Was beer one of the reasons humans embraced farming? Journey through 5,000 years of brewing history backed by historical sources and archaeological evidence. This episode is for history lovers, archaeology enthusiasts, and…
